text: The word of the LORD came to me:
You shall not take a wife, and you shall have no sons or daughters in this place.
For this is what the LORD says concerning the sons and daughters born in this place, concerning the mothers who bear them and the fathers who father them in this land:

versions.text: For this is what the LORD says concerning the sons and daughters born in this place, concerning the mothers who bear them and the fathers who beget them in this land:
versions.explanation: "Beget" is archaic and stumbles in oral reading; a plainer verb keeps the parallel with "bear" and reads more smoothly aloud.

text: They will die of deadly diseases. No one will mourn for them or bury them; they will lie like dung on the ground. They will perish by sword and famine, and their corpses will become food for the birds of the sky and the beasts of the earth.

For this is what the LORD says: Do not enter a house where there is mourning; do not go to lament or console them. For I have withdrawn my peace from this people, declares the LORD—my steadfast love and my mercy.
Both great and small will die in this land. They will not be buried, and no one will mourn for them or cut himself or shave his head for them.
No one will break bread for the mourner to comfort him for the dead, nor give him the cup of consolation to drink for his father or his mother.
And do not enter a house where there is feasting, to sit with them and eat and drink.

For this is what the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, says: Before your very eyes and in your days I will silence in this place the sound of joy and gladness, the voice of the bridegroom and the voice of the bride.
When you tell this people all these words, they will ask you, "Why has the LORD decreed all this great disaster against us? What is our guilt? What sin have we committed against the LORD our God?"
Then say to them: Because your fathers abandoned me, declares the LORD, and followed other gods, served them and bowed down to them—they abandoned me and did not keep my law.
And you have done worse than your fathers. Look how each of you follows the stubbornness of his evil heart instead of listening to me.
So I will hurl you out of this land into a land neither you nor your fathers have known, and there you will serve other gods day and night, for I will show you no favor.
Therefore the days are coming, declares the LORD, when it will no longer be said, "As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the people of Israel up out of the land of Egypt,"

but rather, "As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the people of Israel up out of the land of the north and out of all the lands where he had driven them." For I will bring them back to their own soil, which I gave to their fathers.

versions.text: but rather, "As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the people of Israel up out of the land of the north and out of all the lands where he had driven them." For I will bring them back to the land I gave their fathers.
versions.explanation: The Hebrew אַדְמָתָם means "their own soil/land" — the possessive is significant here, since the promise is restoration to the land that belongs to them. The present rendering drops the possessive.

text: Look, I am sending for many fishermen, declares the LORD, and they will catch them. After that I will send for many hunters, and they will hunt them down on every mountain and hill and out of the clefts of the rocks.
For my eyes are on all their ways. They are not hidden from me, and their guilt is not concealed from my sight.
First I will repay them double for their guilt and their sin, because they have defiled my land with the carcasses of their vile idols and have filled my inheritance with their abominations.

O LORD, my strength and my stronghold, my refuge in the day of trouble, to you the nations will come from the ends of the earth and say: "Our fathers inherited nothing but lies, worthless idols of no benefit at all."
Can a man make gods for himself? Such are no gods at all!
Therefore I will make them know—this time I will make them know my hand and my might—and they will know that my name is the LORD.
